# Recognition Flow Checklist: P-RF02 — Speech-to-text / OCR processing

**Purpose**: Validate the requirements quality of the audio transcription and photo OCR recognition/review/error flows — state definitions, error recovery, idempotency/data-integrity guarantees, and abandonment/lifecycle safety — before this unit moves to `/speckit-tasks` / `/speckit-implement`.
**Created**: 2026-10-13
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Requirement Completeness

- [ ] CHK001 Are the four audio states ("Processando", "Transcrito", "Erro", and the in-flight "Salvar" moment) each fully specified with their visible elements and entry-creation side effects? [Completeness, Spec §FR-001–FR-004]
- [ ] CHK002 Are the four photo states ("Processando OCR", "Reconhecido", "Erro", and the in-flight "Salvar"/"Salvar só a foto" moments) each fully specified with their visible elements and entry-creation side effects? [Completeness, Spec §FR-005–FR-008]
- [ ] CHK003 Is the behavior specified for a save-call failure that occurs *after* a successful transcription/recognition (i.e., `POST /entries` itself fails from "Transcrito"/"Reconhecido"), as distinct from a recognition failure? [Gap, Spec §FR-002/FR-006]
- [ ] CHK004 Are requirements defined for what happens if the connectivity check inside "Salvar só a foto" or the OCR retry fails partway (e.g., connectivity lost between the check and the call)? [Gap, Spec Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK005 Is the exact wording of the fixed placeholder content for "Salvar só a foto" specified, or is its absence explicitly and intentionally deferred to implementation? [Completeness, Spec Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK006 Are requirements defined for how "Áudio — Erro" and "Foto — Erro" are each dismissed (beyond retry), consistent with User Story 5's abandonment paths? [Completeness, Spec §FR-011]
- [ ] CHK007 Are requirements defined for the maximum/expected duration of "Processando"/"Transcrevendo" and "Processando OCR" before a timeout is considered a failure? [Gap, Spec §FR-003/FR-007]

## Requirement Clarity

- [ ] CHK008 Is "no usable text" (triggering "Áudio — Erro" / "Foto — Erro") defined with an objective criterion (e.g., empty string, whitespace-only) rather than left to interpretation? [Clarity, Spec §FR-003/FR-007]
- [ ] CHK009 Is "a save for that capture is already in flight" (the double-tap guard) defined precisely enough to identify its start and end boundaries? [Clarity, Spec §FR-010]
- [ ] CHK010 Is "the same already-held audio/image" (used by "Tentar novamente") clearly scoped to mean the original, unmodified capture rather than any edited review text? [Clarity, Spec §FR-003/FR-007]
- [ ] CHK011 Is the "offline-appropriate message" required for a photo OCR attempted while offline distinguished clearly enough from the generic "Não foi possível reconhecer o texto" failure copy to be implementable as a distinct message? [Clarity, Spec Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK012 Is "whitespace-only" content (disabling "Salvar") defined precisely (e.g., which characters count as whitespace) for both the audio and photo review fields? [Clarity, Spec §FR-009]

## Requirement Consistency

- [ ] CHK013 Are the "discard on abandonment" requirements (FR-011, User Story 5) consistent across all three states (Processando/Transcrevendo, Transcrito/Reconhecido, Erro) for both modalities, with no modality-specific exception left unstated? [Consistency, Spec §FR-011]
- [ ] CHK014 Is the backgrounding-vs-process-kill distinction (Edge Cases) applied consistently to both audio and photo flows, matching RF01's established precedent without introducing a new divergence? [Consistency, Spec Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK015 Are the "exactly one entry per confirmed capture" guarantees (FR-010) worded consistently for the three distinct confirmation actions ("Salvar" from Transcrito, "Salvar" from Reconhecido, "Salvar só a foto")? [Consistency, Spec §FR-010]
- [ ] CHK016 Does the confidence-ignoring requirement (FR-006, Clarification 3) stay consistent with Key Entities' statement that `confidence` "is carried through this state but never branched on," with no contradicting requirement elsewhere? [Consistency, Spec §FR-006]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality / Measurability

- [ ] CHK017 Can "100% of audio captures... reach the editable Transcrito review state before any entry is created" (SC-001) be objectively verified from the stated FRs alone, without additional interpretation? [Measurability, Spec §SC-001]
- [ ] CHK018 Is "at least one retry attempt" (SC-003) measurable as a concrete, testable count rather than an open-ended allowance? [Measurability, Spec §SC-003]
- [ ] CHK019 Is "0% of entries created... have empty or whitespace-only content" (SC-005) testable given the "Salvar só a foto" placeholder path, which intentionally has non-empty but non-recognized content? [Measurability, Spec §SC-005]
- [ ] CHK020 Are success criteria defined for the save-call-failure scenario identified in CHK003, or does success criteria coverage stop at recognition success/failure only? [Gap, Spec Success Criteria]

## Scenario Coverage

- [ ] CHK021 Are requirements defined for the primary (happy-path) flow for both audio and photo recognition, ending in a created entry? [Coverage, Spec §User Story 1/3]
- [ ] CHK022 Are requirements defined for the exception/error flow for both modalities, including the retry path? [Coverage, Spec §User Story 2/4]
- [ ] CHK023 Are requirements defined for the recovery-without-recognition flow unique to photo ("Salvar só a foto")? [Coverage, Spec §User Story 4]
- [ ] CHK024 Are requirements defined for the abandonment flow across every intermediate state for both modalities? [Coverage, Spec §User Story 5]
- [ ] CHK025 Are requirements defined for the alternate flow where the user edits the reviewed text before saving, for both modalities? [Coverage, Spec §FR-002/FR-006]
- [ ] CHK026 Are requirements defined for a repeated/rapid "Tentar novamente" tap during an in-flight recognition attempt, for both modalities? [Coverage, Spec Edge Cases]

## Edge Case Coverage

- [ ] CHK027 Is the edge case of editing the reviewed text down to empty/whitespace addressed for both the audio and photo review fields, not just one? [Edge Case, Spec Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK028 Is the offline-at-OCR-time edge case's required behavior distinguished from the offline-at-save-time requirement already established by RF01, so neither is accidentally conflated with the other? [Edge Case, Spec Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK029 Is the double-tap-on-"Salvar" edge case's requirement specific enough to state what happens to the second, ignored tap (silently dropped vs. visibly rejected)? [Clarity, Spec Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK030 Is the backgrounded-app edge case's "unsaved edits resume normally" requirement specific about which state(s) this applies to (Processando included, or only Transcrito/Reconhecido/Erro)? [Clarity, Spec Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK031 Is a retry on a genuinely illegible image (edge case: "Tentar novamente" on the illegible fixture) required to behave identically to a first attempt, with no special-cased "already failed once" handling? [Edge Case, Spec Edge Cases]

## Non-Functional Requirements

- [ ] CHK032 Are latency/loading-indicator requirements (RNF01) explicitly connected to the "Processando"/"Processando OCR" states' required appearance timing, rather than left implicit? [Gap, Constitution RNF01]
- [ ] CHK033 Are connectivity requirements for "Salvar só a foto" and "Tentar novamente" (OCR) stated with the same rigor as RF01's established offline-blocks-writes rule, including what user-facing message appears when blocked? [Completeness, Spec Edge Cases/Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK034 Are requirements defined for how many in-flight recognition/save network calls may exist concurrently for a single capture (beyond the double-tap guard already covering repeat *user* triggers)? [Gap, Spec §FR-010]

## Dependencies & Assumptions

- [ ] CHK035 Is the assumption that RF01's `_pendingAudioPath`/`_pendingImagePath` mechanism can be reused unchanged for "Tentar novamente" validated against this unit's new Processando→Transcrito/Reconhecido split, not just RF01's original single-step flow? [Assumption, Plan.md Storage]
- [ ] CHK036 Is the dependency on RF01 already being implemented (audio/photo capture, connectivity gating precedent) explicitly stated as a precondition for this unit's requirements to be testable? [Dependency, Spec Input/Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK037 Is the assumption that entries are immutable (no `PATCH`/`DELETE /entries/:id`), making the review step the only correction opportunity, consistent with the frozen backend contract this unit must not change? [Assumption, Spec Assumptions, Constitution Principle III]

## Ambiguities & Conflicts

- [ ] CHK038 Is there any residual ambiguity in whether "Foto — Reconhecido" with `low` confidence should differ at all from `high` confidence beyond "no visual distinction" (e.g., analytics, logging) that the spec does not address? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-006, Clarification 3]
- [ ] CHK039 Does the spec's requirement that this unit "replaces" RF01's placeholder recognition UX (Clarification 1) conflict with Constitution Principle I's general stance against editing already-delivered units, or is the supersession scoped narrowly enough to avoid that conflict? [Conflict-check, Spec Clarification 1, Constitution Principle I]
